consent.title: Fitbit / Google Health Wearables Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating your Fitbit (Google Health) data to our study. The data that we ask you to donate will be used for academic research to gain insight into physical activity, sleep, and wellbeing behaviors. Only daily summaries are extracted: movement (steps, distance, calories, active minutes, Active Zone Minutes), heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, blood oxygen and breathing rate per day, your sleep logs, and your recorded exercises. Your name, email address, date of birth, profile, paired devices, location and GPS data, weight, nutrition, menstrual and ECG data are never read or transmitted.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. You can filter by date, exclude exercise types, and delete rows from the data before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please request a copy of your Fitbit data through Google Takeout: go to takeout.google.com, click "Deselect all", tick only "Fitbit" (called "Google Health" on newer accounts), and create the export as a .zip file. Google will email you a download link, usually within a few hours. Download the .zip file and upload it here without unpacking it. If Google split your export into several .zip files, upload the one that contains the Fitbit / Google Health folder.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments for large exports.
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded file might be incorrect, corrupted, or void of Fitbit data.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any recognizable Fitbit data in the uploaded file. This could mean:
issuePoints: The file is not a Google Takeout export that includes Fitbit / Google Health
Your export was split into several .zip files and this part does not contain the Fitbit folder
The export was unpacked and re-zipped, changing its folder structure
The file is corrupted or incomplete
Your account has no activity, sleep, or exercise data
upload.checkFile: Please check that you have uploaded the original Takeout .zip containing the Fitbit / Google Health folder or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the file is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take a while for large exports.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. You can filter by date range and exclude specific exercise types. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
